key_notes: Key 1 (t=3.44s): Initial archival pose of mountain; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=4.56s): Mid-sequence articulation of mountain; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=5.8s): Peak dynamic extension of mountain over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=7.04s): Follow-through and settle of mountain with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of mountain (3.44s..7.04s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
